channel.title: Niccolò Parlanti | Research
channel.description: Offensive security research and field notes.

item.title: A mask shall not answer questions about what it hides.
item.description: LIKE-wildcard injection: a public leaderboard masked account numbers in its output but let search filters test the hidden digits.

item.title: A signature shall not vouch for what the parser swallowed.
item.description: Unauthenticated XXE in SAML: local DTD reuse turned a signed error response into a server-file disclosure channel.

item.title: A template shall not promote its author.
item.description: Server-side template injection: brace-free QWeb syntax passed the WAF, then exposed privileged database reads and writes.

item.title: An identifier shall not choose the route.
item.description: Path-only SSRF: a product ID redirected a backend request to an internal staff directory, then a decoding error exposed the response.

item.title: Remember the device. Forget the password.
item.description: Recoverable password storage: a remember-me cookie retained a Base64-encoded password for 180 days, readable by page scripts.

item.title: The shopper shall not set the clock.
item.description: Pricing logic abuse: a guest-writable shopper context activated a scheduled future discount in the product response and basket.

item.title: When an echo endpoint becomes a script runner
item.description: A missing Content-Type header, Go’s MIME detection, and the browser behavior behind CVE-2026-43644.

item.title: The moment JSON stops being data
item.description: Following a constructor name into dynamic code generation in TeleJSON.

item.title: A valid token shall speak for one account only.
item.description: Account impersonation through email normalization: distinct authenticated subjects resolved to the same application account.

item.title: An invitation shall admit its recipient. Nobody else.
item.description: Privilege escalation through invitation hijacking: a missing recipient check assigned an administrator role to a different account.

item.title: A service shall not lend its privileges to strangers.
item.description: Missing API authentication: cloud-identity-backed processing and a signed diagnostic link exposed internal error data.

item.title: My experience with eJPTv2
item.description: Preparation, practice, and lessons from my first penetration testing certification.

item.title: Evading Deepfake Classifier with Adversarial Attacks
item.description: An in-depth analysis of white-box adversarial attacks against deepfake-image detectors, exploring the vulnerability of AI-driven systems.

item.title: Cryptographically enforced access control
item.description: Desing and implement a Cryptographically Enforced Access Control using CP-ABE

item.title: THS challenges: cryptography
item.description: Working through cryptographic puzzles, from assumptions to solutions.

item.title: THS Challenges Writeups - Misc
item.description: Writeups of the challenges of THS - Misc

item.title: Vulnerabilities Identification and Exploitation
item.description: An extensive report on security testing practices for identifying, assessing, and exploiting vulnerabilities in web applications, detailed with real-world data and code examples.

item.title: Dante CTF: web challenges
item.description: An earlier set of hands-on web security challenges and their solutions.

item.title: Dante CTF Writeups - Forensics
item.description: Writeups of the Dante CTF 2023 - Forensics

item.title: Image watermarking with DWT, SVD, and DCT
item.description: Embedding of a watermak using DWT-SVD and a DWT-DCT tranform.

item.title: FastTicket Web App
item.description: A site that shows ticket offices, bus stops and tramway stops in the Florence area, using geolocation and routing programs to guide the user to the chosen destination.

item.title: Todo List
item.description: TodoApp is a user-friendly and feature-rich task management application that helps users stay organized, increase productivity, and effortlessly manage their tasks and to-do lists.

item.title: Kruskal Algorithm
item.description: Theoretical report on connected components and kruskal algorithm, with tests and related analysis.

item.title: Edit distance with and without N-grams
item.description: This project implements the Edit Distance algorithm with and without N-Gram support, providing a versatile tool for string similarity and comparison tasks in various domains.
